title: A large term from a three-halves sum
statement: Let $I$ be a finite set and let $a_i\ge0$ for every $i\in I$, with $\sum_{i\in I}a_i>0$. Suppose $A\ge0$ and $A\le\sum_{i\in I}a_i^{3/2}$. Then some $i\in I$ satisfies $\left(A/\sum_{j\in I}a_j\right)^2\le a_i$.
replaced: Let $I$ be finite and let $a_i\ge0$ have positive sum. If $A\ge0$ and $A\le\sum_i a_i^{3/2}$, then some $i\in I$ satisfies $(A/\sum_ja_j)^2\le a_i$.
